title: When forgiveness keeps feeling costly in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind knows the wound but does not know how to loosen its grip. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru links forgiveness to freedom, fearless return, and the end of inner replay. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne. Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment.
actionPrompt: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
